title: Look for a Word Containing love
text: The target word can be love or a longer word like loved. A useful pattern should match love and then allow additional letters before the space.

title: Words After love
text: In "I love the animations", which two words should be captured?

title: Capture Only the Desired Output
text: Because re.findall returns the contents of a capturing group when parentheses are present, the group should surround the two words after the love-containing word, not the word love itself.

title: Why the Correct Pattern Works
text: The pattern r"love[A-Za-z]*\s(\w+\s\w+)" matches love plus optional letters, then a space, and captures the next two words inside the group.
